tool.name: apple_app_store_data
tool.title: Apple App Store Search, App Details & Top Charts
tool.description:
Get Apple App Store data from Apple's own public endpoints in one call: keyword search results, exact app records by id or URL, and the top-free / top-paid / top-grossing charts for any store country. Each row carries app id, bundle id, name, developer, price, rating and rating count, genre, version, release/update dates and the App Store URL.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/apple-app-store-scraper'.
- Side Effects: Reads Apple's public iTunes endpoints and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account. No login, no API key, no browser.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typically 2-10 seconds; starts from $0.002 per row plus a small per-run start fee. One call returns at most 100 rows, and every row the Actor produces is billed, so keep keywords x countries x limit (plus charts x countries x limit) at or below 100.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for ASO keyword research, app market and chart tracking, competitor app metadata, or building app datasets for analysis and AI pipelines.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for app reviews, for Google Play or other stores, or for private analytics such as downloads and revenue, which Apple does not publish.
- Named alternatives: Use 'app_store_reviews_search' for iOS customer reviews and ratings; use 'google_play_reviews_search' for Android apps.

Honest limits: chart rows come from Apple's legacy top-charts feed and therefore have no rating or version fields (rating is null); keyword search returns whatever Apple returns for that country, and a run that returns zero rows fails loudly instead of charging for an empty dataset.

search_terms.description: App Store search keywords. Each keyword returns up to limit_per_term apps per country. Leave out (or pass []) when you only want app details or charts; nothing is searched then.

app_ids.description: Numeric Apple app ids ('284882215') or apps.apple.com URLs to get exact app records instead of search results.

charts.description: Also collect these top charts for each country.

countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes (us, gb, de, jp, ...). Each country is queried separately; defaults to us.

limit_per_term.description: Maximum apps returned per keyword. Each row is billed; defaults to 25.

limit_per_chart.description: Maximum entries returned per chart. Each row is billed; defaults to 25.

rowType.title: Row type
rowType.description: 'app' for search or lookup rows, 'chart' for top-chart rows.

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: Apple track id; primary key of an app.

sellerName.title: Seller
sellerName.description: Seller name on the App Store record.

country.title: Country
country.description: Store country code the row came from.

foundBy.title: Found by
foundBy.description: How the row was found: search, lookup or chart.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Keyword that produced the row, when found by search.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price in the store currency; 0 means free.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Average rating across all versions; null on chart rows.

ratingsCount.title: Ratings count
ratingsCount.description: Number of ratings; null on chart rows.

version.title: Version
version.description: Current version string; null on chart rows.
